narr: A cold front moved across eastern Nebraska which had observed unseasonably warm temperatures in the past couple of days. The front set off a line of storms that produced strong wind gusts and large hail. The strongest measured wind gust was 67 mph in Sarpy County and there were several 1.75-inch hail reports in Otoe County. A flash flood was reported in Sarpy County as 2-3 inches of rain fell across the county.
ev: Public reported water over the road at 48th and Woolwort.
Public reported water over roadway near Locust and Carter Lake Shore Drive.
Public reported flooding along I480 heading toward US75 south.
The Emergency manager reported street flooding in parts of Olde Towne near Harlan and Industrial Drive. No structures were impacted but there were several stalled vehicles.
Trained spotter reported street flooding at Bell and Dodge intersection. Water levels came up to the bottom of car doors. A video was received via social media showing the flooding.
